list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat: introduce meno_services package and implement local storage
This commit introduces the new `meno_services` package to handle interactions with external services like APIs and databases.
Key changes include: - Creation of the `meno_services` package with initial setup and dependencies (`flutter_secure_storage`, `shared_preferences`, `disco`). - Implementation of a `LocalStorage` interface (`LocalStorageImpl`) that abstracts synchronous (SharedPreferences) and secure asynchronous (FlutterSecureStorage) storage. - Addition of a theme-aware `MLogo` widget to the `meno_design_system` package. - Refactoring of the `meno_domain` package to include a new `MRoutes` class for centralized route management and the `LocalStorage` abstraction. - Integration of `meno_services` into the main app and `meno_onboarding` package, including dependency injection setup for storage services.

task.summary:
refactor: restructure codebase into a monorepo
This commit restructures the entire codebase from a single monolithic application into a Melos-managed monorepo.
Key changes include: - Deleting the top-level `lib`, `android`, `ios`, and other root project files. - Introducing a `melos.yaml` configuration to define the new workspace structure. - Creating a new `apps/meno_app` for the main application. - Establishing `packages/meno_design_system`, `packages/meno_auth`, and `packages/meno_domain` to modularize the codebase and separate concerns.

feat: implement value objects and exceptions in meno_domain
Introduces a base `ValueObject` class to enforce validation and immutability for domain-specific types.
Adds the following value objects: - `Id`: For handling unique identifiers (UUID v4). - `Email`: Validates email format. - `Password`: Provides validation for both sign-in and sign-up scenarios. - `SingleLineString`: For non-empty, single-line strings. - `MultiLineString`: For strings with a maximum length. - `ImageObject`: Handles validation for image files (format, size) and URLs.
Implements a `ValueException` sealed class with `freezed` to represent various validation failures.
Updates `pubspec.yaml` with new dependencies (`equatable`, `uuid`, `intl`) and configures `analysis_options.yaml` to exclude generated files.

refactor: introduce new models and value objects
This commit refactors the `meno_domain` package by introducing a comprehensive set of new models and value objects.
- **Models**: Adds new data models for `User`, `UserCredential`, `UserRole`, `Settings`, and various `Bible`-related entities (`Bible`, `Book`, `Chapter`, `Verse`, `Translation`). - **Value Objects**: Renames `ImageFile` to `ImageObject` and introduces new value objects, centralizing their exports. - **Converters**: Implements `JsonConverter` classes for handling serialization and deserialization of the new value objects (`Id`, `Email`, `ImageObject`, `SingleLineString`, `MultiLineString`). - **Exports**: Adds barrel files (`models.dart`, `converters.dart`, etc.) to simplify imports across the application.

feat: add broadcast and participant models
Introduces new data models for the broadcast feature within the `meno_domain` package.
This includes: - `Broadcast` model to represent a live or scheduled audio session. - `Participant` model to define users within a broadcast. - `BroadcastStatus` and `ParticipantRole` enums. - A `ParticipantRoleConverter` for case-insensitive JSON serialization.
feat: add ended broadcast data model

Refactor: move converters import to model files
This moves the `converters.dart` import from the main library file directly into the specific model files (`user.dart`, `broadcast.dart`, `participant.dart`) that utilize it. This change improves encapsulation and makes dependencies more explicit within the domain models.

feat: add new meno_onboarding package and update dependencies
This commit introduces the new `meno_onboarding` feature package, complete with its initial file structure, dependencies, and basic implementation.
Additionally, it updates dependencies and configurations across the monorepo: - Adds `solidart`, `disco`, and related linting rules to the `meno_auth` package. - Removes the git submodule mapping for `meno_design_system`. - Adds the new `meno_onboarding` package to the Melos workspace configuration. - Updates various IDE and project configuration files.
